findings.claim: The interface accepts any FeatureKey but only checks grant.enabled, so a future caller passing a metered feature like sponsored_transactions would be admitted even when its quota is exhausted, silently bypassing the metered allowance. The parameter type should be narrowed to BinaryFeature to prevent this.

This controller and its associated service should live in the Safe Shield module rather than in Spaces, consistent with how other Space-scoped routes (space-relay.controller.ts, space-counterfactual-safes.controller.ts, entitlements.controller.ts) each declare their spaces/:spaceId/... routes from their own owning module while importing SpacesModule, and each performs the same assertMember gating from outside Spaces, meaning the membership check is not a valid reason for this controller to reside in Spaces.
